<p>I am an Assistant Professor of Computer Science at Alfred University and have taught as a
Mentor/Teaching Assistant at Iowa State University. My teaching focuses on connecting
theory with practical applications through hands-on, project-driven learning, with
emphasis on machine learning, AI, scientific computing, and web technologies.</p>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const details = document.querySelectorAll(".course-card");
  details.forEach((detail) => {
    detail.addEventListener("toggle", () => {
      if(detail.open) {
        details.forEach((d) => {
          if(d !== detail) d.open = false;
        });
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("teach-network");
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const page = canvas.parentElement;
  const SYMBOLS = ["\u{1F4D6}", "✏️", "\u{1F393}", "\u{1F4A1}", "\u{1F4D0}", "\u{1F52C}"];
  const AREA_PER_ITEM = 26000;
  let width, height, items;

  function resize() {
    width = canvas.width = page.offsetWidth;
    height = canvas.height = page.offsetHeight;
    const count = Math.max(10, Math.round((width * height) / AREA_PER_ITEM));
    items = Array.from({ length: count }, () => spawn(Math.random() * height));
  }

  function spawn(y) {
    return {
      x: Math.random() * width,
      y: y === undefined ? height + 40 : y,
      size: 18 + Math.random() * 16,
      speed: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25,
      drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
      wobble: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      symbol: SYMBOLS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SYMBOLS.length)],
      opacity: 0.18 + Math.random() * 0.22,
    };
  }

  function step() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    for (const it of items) {
      it.y -= it.speed;
      it.wobble += 0.01;
      it.x += Math.sin(it.wobble) * it.drift;

      if (it.y < -40) {
        Object.assign(it, spawn());
      }

      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = it.opacity;
      ctx.font = `${it.size}px sans-serif`;
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText(it.symbol, it.x, it.y);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(step);

  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(page);

  const revealTargets = document.querySelectorAll(
    ".clavr-content > p, .clavr-content > .clavr-section, .clavr-content .course-card"
  );
  revealTargets.forEach((el, i) => {
    el.classList.add("clavr-reveal");
    el.style.transitionDelay = `${Math.min(i * 60, 300)}ms`;
  });

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    (entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add("clavr-in-view");
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    },
    { threshold: 0, rootMargin: "200px 0px -40px 0px" }
  );
  revealTargets.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));

  setTimeout(() => {
    revealTargets.forEach((el) => el.classList.add("clavr-in-view"));
  }, 2500);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("footprint-canvas");
  const page = canvas ? canvas.parentElement : null;
  if (!canvas || !page) return;

  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let width, height;
  const footprints = [];
  const LIFE_MS = 1700;
  const MIN_STEP = 30;
  let lastX = null;
  let lastY = null;
  let side = 1;

  function resize() {
    width = canvas.width = page.offsetWidth;
    height = canvas.height = page.offsetHeight;
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(page);

  function handleMove(e) {
    const rect = page.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    if (lastX === null) {
      lastX = x;
      lastY = y;
      return;
    }

    const dx = x - lastX;
    const dy = y - lastY;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

    if (dist >= MIN_STEP) {
      const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      side *= -1;
      footprints.push({ x, y, angle, side, born: performance.now() });
      if (footprints.length > 80) footprints.shift();
      lastX = x;
      lastY = y;
    }
  }

  page.addEventListener("mousemove", handleMove);
  page.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
    lastX = null;
    lastY = null;
  });

  function drawFootprint(fp, now) {
    const age = now - fp.born;
    if (age > LIFE_MS) return false;

    const opacity = 0.65 * (1 - age / LIFE_MS);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(fp.x, fp.y);
    ctx.rotate(fp.angle + Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.translate(fp.side * 6, 0);
    ctx.scale(fp.side, 1);
    ctx.globalAlpha = opacity;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2c5d85";

    // forefoot pad
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -5, 5.2, 5.8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // heel pad (gap between the two mimics a shoe-sole print)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 8.5, 3.4, 4.2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
    return true;
  }

  function step() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    const now = performance.now();
    for (let i = footprints.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (!drawFootprint(footprints[i], now)) {
        footprints.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
})();
</script>
